notes.title: This horror game is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello,
The publishing rights of this game have been taken from the KAYDEM Studio developer team and are now published by us. We want you to know that we have seen your complaints about the removal of the game and we understand you very well. We apologize on behalf of the development team for your negative experience and would like to announce that we are putting this game on sale forever.
Regards.
